About

João Vaz
Monteiro

Photographer  ·  Director of Photography  ·  Filmmaker

Hi, I'm João — a storyteller and visual artist dedicated to creating meaningful narratives through photography and cinematography.

Whether behind the camera, in the editing suite, or scaling a mountain for the perfect shot, I aim to craft work that resonates deeply and authentically.

I've collaborated with clients on diverse projects, from commercial campaigns to documenting Portugal's climbing culture. These experiences have sharpened my eye for detail and my ability to adapt to any creative challenge.

I approach each project as a chance to merge creativity with authenticity, whether it's producing compelling visuals for brands, capturing dynamic outdoor adventures, or preserving the essence of meaningful events.

When I'm not working, you'll find me exploring climbing routes, uncovering hidden trails, or drawing inspiration from the world around me. Adventure fuels my creativity and keeps me grounded.
